Patient story 01 ( đặt tên : Dental Implants) . Khi nhấp vào nội dung thì landing page sẽ hiện lên câu chuyện của ông này là : AFTER 5 MONTHS OF IMPLANT TREATMENT AT EMIS DENTAL, OUR PATIENT HAS OFFICIALLY COMPLETED THEIR NEW SMILE AND CAN ENJOY COMFORTABLE CHEWING AGAIN
In this clinical case, an international patient came to Emis Dental with multiple missing upper teeth that had been left untreated for many years, significantly affecting daily eating and quality of life.
After a comprehensive examination, 3D CT Cone Beam scanning, bone density assessment, and discussion of the patient's expectations, the Implant specialist at Emis Dental developed a personalized treatment plan for each missing tooth area.
Implant placement surgery.
Monitoring the osseointegration process over 5 months.
Placement of Implant-supported porcelain crowns once ideal Implant stability was achieved.
RESULTS AFTER TREATMENT
Completed Implant-supported porcelain restorations with excellent stability.
Restored chewing function close to that of natural teeth.
Natural-looking aesthetics that blend harmoniously with the remaining teeth.
No concerns about loose teeth or discomfort commonly associated with removable dentures.
The patient is satisfied with their new smile and can enjoy eating comfortably again.
